summary: Decommission the redundant standalone EKODIBIZ Invest business path and site-local admin while preserving the shared EKODI Invest Core on /invest.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform owner explicitly instructed on 2026-10-23 to cease independent operation of the EKODIBIZ Investment/IR website and remove its domain-path-specific source and server configuration.
implementation: Remove EKODIBIZ investment public and admin page implementations, catalog exposure, local admin registration, monitoring, and deployment expectations.
Handle legacy GET/HEAD path requests with 308 redirects to /ekodibiz and reject non-read operations with 410; retain no standalone public or admin surface.
Preserve shared /invest common-service source code, authentication, user records, and investment research databases.
Retain historical approved governance records as audit evidence and continue the guarded CI, staging, production-verification release protocol.
mandatoryRules: Never delete or disable EKODI Invest Core (/invest) as part of this retirement.
No production schema, shared data, identity, or unrelated workspace removal is authorized.
The retired EKODIBIZ investment site cannot be silently reintroduced as an independent surface without a new approved change.
No reduction in legal or regulated investment safeguards.
Require official EKODI AI Orchestrator-issued release provenance, green checks, staged verification, and real production confirmation.
validation: production old-path redirect and shared /invest smoke verification
rollback: If retirement causes a regression, revert only this site-specific retirement through protected release after risk assessment; do not restore regulated functionality or remove shared Invest Core.
